page.layout: Running head at top, centred, with page number 299 at the top right. Two engraved medallion portraits side by side near the top, each with its legend around the rim (left: PET. PRIMALDAVS; right: ANT. VERDERIVS, D. VALLISPRIVATVS). Below them, one column of running text in two paragraphs. Catchword and signature at the foot right: Ttt 6. No notes in the margins.

main_text.l: PET. PRIMALDAVS
ANT. VERDERIVS D. VALLISPRIVATVS[?]
PETRVS Primaldayus, Andegauensis, Scutifer, dominus
à Primaldaya & Barrea, Academiam Gallicam scripsit in qua
per Dialogum non minus doctè quam ornatè de rectâ morum
informatione, ac de ratione bene beatèque viuendi in quouis
vitæ genere disputat. Atque huius operis beneficio debet in eo-
rum numero constitui qui sua ætate floruerūt in bene dicēdo.
Eóque maiore laurea dignus est, quod armis dat operam & li-
teris. Prior huius Academiæ pars tam fœliciter excepta fuit ab
omnibus iis qui fauent literis; vt motus fuerit ad editionem al-
terius partis, quæ simul typis mandata est.
ANTONIVS Verderius, Scutifer, dominus Vallispriua-
tæ & Luriaci, Regis consiliarius & Ærarij Regij apud Lugdu-
nenses Antigraphæus, oriundus ex Verderiorum familia Fore-
siensis prouinciæ; orbatus cum esset patre menses tres natus,
Mater eius nomine Omnisanēta Terrassa, curauit postquam
grandior euasit paulò, vt instituereter in literis: in quas tam
amico fuit animo, vt nihil præter virtutem & scientias amplecte-
retur. Magna fuit suorum expectatio de illo: & nisi rei Familia-
ris administrationem suscepisset, vxorem ducens annum agens
duntaxat xix. dici non potest quantos fructus percepisset.
Quamuis ab eo tempore literarum studia commiscuit cum di-
sciplina militari & publicorum munerum administratione: nec
parum profuere vigiliæ suæ, ex quibus scripta permulta emana-
runt: videlicet, Poemata Gallica, Prosopographia, Variæ
lectiones, in Aristophanis Plutum comment. Bartholomæi Tegij
responsa, Bibliotheca Gallica, Imagines deorū qui ab antiquis
colebantur, partim ex Italico sermone in Gallicū versæ, partim
de propria industria adauctæ, & alia pleraq;. Habet etiā præ ma-
nibus Senecæ philosophi omnia opera in Gallicā linguā versa,
cum annotationibus & scholiis, quæ breui in lucē editurus est.

page.notes: Two engraved medallion portraits (a bearded man in a ruff on the left, a bearded man in a ruff on the right) above the text; their legends are transcribed above as printed, with the right legend's second word uncertain. Page number read as 299. Signature Ttt 6 is printed centred-right under the text. Some accents and tildes (rectâ, dicēdo, floruerūt, Omnisanēta) are uncertain at this scan resolution.
